title: HVAC Service Call Completion Report
subtitle: Residential HVAC Service Call: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: HVAC Service Call Completion Report covers heating or cooling unit, thermostat, duct path, condensate, and occupied comfort zone. The home-service coordinator records Residential HVAC Service Call performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. HVAC Service Call Completion Report keeps Residential HVAC Service Call exceptions visible until the home-service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use HVAC Service Call Completion Report at residence, equipment location, thermostat zone, and exterior unit area. Document heating or cooling unit, thermostat, duct path, condensate, and occupied comfort zone identity before Residential HVAC Service Call begins. Compare heating or cooling unit, thermostat, duct path, condensate, and occupied comfort zone findings with stated Residential HVAC Service Call criteria; route unresolved Residential HVAC Service Call issues to qualified HVAC technician. For HVAC Service Call Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential HVAC Service Call. Ask qualified HVAC technician to review Residential HVAC Service Call conditions beyond the home-service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completion parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Residential HVAC Service Call, identify responsible parties, residence, equipment location, thermostat zone, and exterior unit area, and the linked heating or cooling unit, thermostat, duct path, condensate, and occupied comfort zone source.

fields.label: Equipment type, model, serial, and thermostat zone
Reported comfort issue, onset, prior service, and access condition

sections.title: Performed scope and verification results
sections.guidance: Capture Residential HVAC Service Call facts for heating or cooling unit, thermostat, duct path, condensate, and occupied comfort zone; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential HVAC Service Call completion checks
items: Thermostat call, displayed temperature, and mode response
Filter, airflow, register, and return condition
Indoor and outdoor unit visual condition
Condensate, drain, water, and icing observation
Electrical, fuel, venting, noise, and odor concern
Supply-return temperature or authorized performance result

sections.title: Completion limitation, status, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential HVAC Service Call conditions; have home-service coordinator assign the next Residential HVAC Service Call owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Gas odor, combustion, damaged conductor, or water damage
System cannot be tested or restored safely
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential HVAC Service Call when a fuel, electrical, refrigerant, water, access, or safe-operation concern remains. Retain the available Residential HVAC Service Call proof and route unresolved heating or cooling unit, thermostat, duct path, condensate, and occupied comfort zone scope to home-service coordinator.
